title: CircaGrowth: an ODE model of circadian rhythm, glucose, insulin and growth-hormone (STH) dynamics

creators.name: Abdullayev, Omar
creators.affiliation: School No. 39 named after M. C. Pashayev, Ganja, Azerbaijan

description: CircaGrowth couples a Bergman-type glucose-insulin model with a circadian growth-hormone (STH) secretion term to study how meal timing interacts with nocturnal STH secretion. In the current model, a 23:00 dinner lowers the simulated STH peak by about 1%, and a meal about 45 minutes before the peak lowers it by about 14%. Known limitations are listed in the README. The model is a hypothesis-generation tool, not validated against human data and not medical advice.
